title: Column code block
description: A quiet monospaced code panel at 12px: optional uppercase label and line numbers, strings in the highlight colour, numbers in purple, null/true/false in orange, flags and keys in the primary colour. Long lines run off the edge instead of wrapping.
notes: colours come from tokens, so it reads on light panels and inside a dark-class band alike
the highlighting is a tiny built-in tokenizer for shell and JSON-like snippets, not a full parser
